description.value: Desi Indian Lounge is a modern fine-dining Indian restaurant on Hornby Street in downtown Vancouver, blending traditional regional recipes with elegant lounge-style presentation and a full cocktail bar featuring Indian-inspired drinks. The menu spans tandoori platters, slow-cooked curries, and a wide range of vegetarian options, with several gluten-free and dairy-free items. The restaurant participates in Dine Out Vancouver and offers catering for private and corporate events.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 22m; stands (4 spaces) at 62m; wall_loops (3 spaces) at 89m. Total: 9 spaces.

No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycle-specific amenity appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so the required bike parking criterion cannot be verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is an active, legitimate downtown restaurant with takeout and vegetarian/GF options suitable for touring cyclists, but the required bike parking/visibility criterion is entirely unverifiable from available evidence. An on-the-ground check of the Hornby Street frontage for nearby racks would resolve this.
